title: SearchPlan
description: Cloud Run internal orchestration plan. Built from IntentResult before hitting any retrieval index. NOT sent to the browser or WordPress — internal to Cloud Run only.

intent.description: The parsed IntentResult this plan was derived from.

retrieval_strategy.description: vector_primary: pgvector leads, keyword re-ranks. keyword_fallback: WC text search only (single-word queries or Gemini timeout). hybrid: BM25 + pgvector ANN with reciprocal rank fusion (default for natural-language queries). wc_local: Cloud Run unavailable, WordPress local_search() used.

pgvector_query.description: Embedding query string — keyword join of the intent's keywords, used to generate the vector sent to pgvector. Empty string when retrieval_strategy=wc_local.

provisional_ok.description: If true, the caller may render provisional index results before Gemini-ranked results arrive.
